question: How can mutable linked nodes use stable handles without a second runtime reference representation?
decision: Allow recursive nominal struct field types and reuse identity-bearing named struct values as strong handles; use optional<T> for absent links.
aliasing: assignment, arguments, captures, and field storage copy the handle; field mutation is visible through all aliases
lifetime: strong shared ownership; unlinking does not invalidate retained handles; strong cycles remain until VM teardown
cycle_format: <cycle> on an active-path repeat, with existing acyclic formatting unchanged
artifact_boundary: reuse existing Struct, Field, and AssignField operations; keep cdbc 0.1
